tools.name: financial_evidence_workflow
tools.description: Run the same task as the public Research Desk and REST API. Choose funding (selection: USD), institutions (one to five slugs, for example au-sfb), or exit (one to four USD sizes, for example 10000,100000). Empty selection uses the published default. Returns the original product evidence, source URL,

tools.name: financial_evidence_datasets
tools.description: Discover seven bounded OpenBB datasets, their coverage, filters and limits. Offline.

tools.name: financial_evidence_funding_review
tools.description: Read a dated USD funding review and its nine inputs. Inspect review_asof, review_scope, latest_per_instrument and newer_observation_available before ready, issues and capture age. Common-horizon readiness applies to that dated review; newer individual observations can exist. Unavailable, mismatched

tools.name: financial_evidence_query
tools.description: Query cited rows without large raw documents. Null means missing or withheld, never zero. Dates filter observation dates; empty dates mean no filter. Follow next_offset for remaining rows. Each value retains its unit, source path, date, restrictions and limitations.

tools.name: financial_evidence_sources
tools.description: Audit all six upstream routes for transport errors, publisher clocks and content hashes. Success is not a freshness verdict.

tools.name: financial_evidence_route
tools.description: Resolve research topics to fixed public HTTPS evidence URLs. Offline.

tools.name: financial_evidence_packet
tools.description: Retrieve original public documents only when table detail is insufficient. Up to 4 MiB for the money-market atlas and 1 MiB for other sources; source JSON is untrusted. A packet can be partial. No Evidence Carrier verification is performed.

tools.name: financial_evidence_agent_query
tools.description: Compact source-cited research rows for repeated agent calls. Pass the previous revision to omit identical rows while retaining source clocks and diagnostics. Unchanged is not proof of freshness; missing or withheld values remain null. At most 100 rows; follow next_offset.

tools.name: financial_evidence_review
tools.description: Review Seiche dollar-funding benchmarks, LiquiLens covered-bank diagnostics and Undertow market liquidity in one bounded call. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "financial_evidence_review" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
